user: Can I carry firearms in the Town of Danville and how do I get a firearms permit?
assistant: In the Town of Danville, you can apply for a firearms permit through the Contra Costa Sheriff. However, I do not have information about if you can carry firearms in the Town of Danville.
user: does Town of Danville provide police report and background check letters?
assistant: Yes, town of Danville can provide police report. The police report may be obtained through the Contra Costa County Office of the Sheriff Records Unit. You can contact the Dublin Police Services Business Office (6361 Clark Ave Dublin, CA 94568) or via the business number: (925) 833-6670. On the other hand, background check letter is not provided.  The letter is issued by the Records Department located at Martinez, CA. You can also request background check letter via email to Records Info as well.

got it. how much does it cost to have police report or background check letters?

Danville Police Department can provide you accident reports to an involved party only, for a $5.00 fee. However I do not have information about background check letter cost.

According to page 1, traffic accident reports cost $5.00 and are released only to an involved party. The document does not specify fees for other police reports or background check letters. For police report inquiries, contact the Contra Costa County Office of the Sheriff Records Unit at 925-335-1570 or recordsinfo@so.cccounty.us.

Police Department

1.
How do I file a police report? 

If it is a non-emergency, call dispatch 925-820-2144 to have an officer contact you to set up an appointment to meet at an agreed location. If it is an emergency, call dispatch 911 immediately. 

2.
How do I get a copy of a police report? 

All reports may be obtained through the Contra Costa County Office of the Sheriff Records Unit. (link below)Additionally, traffic collision investigation reports may be obtained through Danville Police Department’s online portal: Online Police Report Access or by calling 866-215-2771 for assistance. We will release accident reports to an involved party only, for a $5.00 fee. Contra Costa County Office of the Sheriff RecordsLink to Website925-335-1570recordsinfo@so.cccounty.us 

3.
Do you take credit cards?

No, we only take exact cash or checks. Checks should be made out to Town of Danville.
